candidate_meta.note: Fictional sample profile for demonstration. Replace with your own (see README).

roles.title: Design Engineer
roles.context: Aircraft interior structures: galley and stowage modules.

bullets.text: Design and detail sheet metal and machined brackets in Siemens NX for galley and stowage modules.
Release manufacturing and installation drawings with GD&T, and own the BOM in Teamcenter.
Run Digital Mock-Up (DMU) clash checks on large assemblies and resolve interferences before release.
Present design changes at Preliminary and Critical Design Reviews (PDR / CDR).
Mentor two junior engineers on NX modelling standards and drawing checks.

roles.title: Engineering Change Analyst
roles.context: Configuration management for the interiors programme.

bullets.text: Process engineering change requests (ECR / ECN) and keep configuration records accurate in Teamcenter.
Track change-request KPIs in Excel and report weekly status to the programme lead.
Modelled gearbox housings and covers in Siemens NX, working to casting and machining constraints.
Supported basic stress checks on housing ribs with the analysis team.
Designed welding and assembly fixtures for the housing line, cutting setup time on the shop floor.

cad_and_plm: Siemens NX — part, assembly and sheet metal modelling

final_year_project.description: Designed and built a pedal-powered water pump prototype as a team of four.

additional.text: Volunteer mentor for a college Formula Student team (chassis design).
